_note: Pre-election check, 30 October 2026: a midterm claim that the ballot itself already answers.

evidence.summary: The general election nominees for Minnesota governor on 3 November 2026 are Amy Klobuchar (DFL) and Lisa Demuth (Republican). Mike Lindell lost the Republican primary to Demuth; NBC's primary results page shows Demuth 43.4 percent, Lindell 32.5 percent. Lindell is not on the November ballot for governor.
evidence.rationale: He said Lindell would win Minnesota by a landslide. Lindell did not win the nomination, so he cannot win the governorship. No later telling is needed to decide this: the claim failed at the primary. The earlier Trump endorsement he cited raised the odds of the nomination but did not deliver it.
